faces.name: National Museum
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here, each player searches their library for a nonland permanent card with their favorite art, shows it off to the table, puts that card into their hand, then shuffles.
As you cast your first spell each turn, describe your favorite thing about it in your best museum curator voice. It costs 2 less to cast.
Whenever chaos ensues, choose a Magic artist. For each nontoken permanent you control by that artist, create a token that's a copy of it.
